senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to cut, v. הֶרֶג,] to kill, put to death.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:3">Num. R. s. 21</cite>, beg. <he>בא לַהֲרָגְךָ השכם להָרְגּוֹ</he> if one comes to kill thee, be the first to kill him; <cite ref="Berakhot 58a:11">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 72a:4">Snh. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>להוֹרְגְּךָ … להוֹרְגוֹ</he>.
Gitt. 56ᵇ כסבור ה׳ את עצמו he (Titus) thought he had killed himself (euphem. for the Lord); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. הָרוּג.

<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:1">Tosef. Gitt. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 3:1">III</cite>), 1 <he>הֲרוּגִין שנהרגו לפני מלחמה ובשעת מלחמה</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>בשעת</he>) those executed (by the Roman government) before and during the Vespasian war; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:7:2">Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵇ</cite> top [read:] <he>הֲרוּגֵי המלחמה ולפני וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:21">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00764"><he>בִּיתֵּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 50a:13">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:11">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הרוגי מלכות</he> martyrs under the Roman government (R. Akiba and his fellow-martyrs), v. <cite ref="L00193"><he>לוּד</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Taanit 18b">Taan. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>נֶהֶרְגוּ</he> were put to death (by the Roman government).
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:4">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>יֵהָרֵג</he> is to be put to death.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 74a:12">Snh. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>עבור ואל תֵּהָרֵג</he> transgress or thou wilt be killed; a. fr.
